svg.title: Use Case Diagram
svg.desc: Use case overview derived from implemented Express routes, role middleware, and integrations.
svg.text: Implemented API capabilities and external integrations
Colored dots identify allowed actors: Guest, Player, Trainer, Admin. External systems are connected by dashed associations.
Payment activation is completed by Stripe webhook. Workout and nutrition access requires an ACTIVE TrainerAssignment.
Chat and location modules are intentionally omitted because their route files contain TODO placeholders only.
